blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in Central Coquitlam
Oasis — 2955 Atlantic Avenue

The building directory's listing headers record "Pets Allowed" and concrete construction, and a current listing records construction as concrete with exercise centre, recreation facilities, sauna/steam room and caretaker among the amenities; listings also describe an outdoor pool, gym and garden lounge.
MThree — 1188 Pinetree Way
Cressey's own project page confirms 48 storeys, 319 homes and completion 2016, with The Summit Club — 9,000 sq. ft. of top-level amenities. Current listings record pets as cats OK at unit level.
Grand Central One — 2978 Glen Drive
Current listings describe Grand Central One as a concrete tower with resort-style amenities including a pool, hot tub, gym and gardens, and record year built 2009 at unit level.
Grand Central 2 — 2968 Glen Drive
By Intergulf. A current listing names the complex "Grand Central 2 by Intergulf," records year built 2013, and lists facilities including an outdoor pool, gym, garden and putting green.
Grand Central 3 — 2975 Atlantic Avenue

By Intergulf, strata plan BCS3495 (a listing record for the building confirms Strata No BCS3495 and Complex Name Grand Central 3). Current listings record year built 2014 (one listing record says 2012 — the majority/current-listing year, 2014, is used here and the conflict is noted), 37 storeys in one listing's building data, freehold strata title, and amenities including a clubhouse, exercise/yoga/table-tennis/billiards rooms, outdoor pool and hot tub, playground and gardens; unit listings record pets as cats OK / pets with restrictions.
Altamonte — 2979 Glen Drive

By Bosa, built 2007 per current listings, which describe it as one of Bosa's concrete buildings with a gas stove in units, and amenities including a playground, exercise centre and guest suite; a current listing records pets as cats OK at unit level.
Parc Laurent — 3071 Glen Drive

Named "PARC LAURANT" [sic] in a listing for the building, which describes an updated lobby and amenities including a workshop, gym, sauna, hot tub, pool table, library, party room and car wash bay, in a quiet location near the aquatic centre and Coquitlam Centre.
Pine & Glen — 1175 Pinetree Way (Onni)

A presale project at Pinetree Way & Glen Drive: three high-rise towers (50-storey and 45-storey condo towers plus a 22-storey market-rental tower) over a 6-storey podium, with 705 condominiums and 186 market rental apartments, estimated completion 2028 (presale-directory sources, secondary). The 186 rental apartments are rental-only and are not condo stock. REDMA applies to developer contracts.
Streets, schools and getting around Central Coquitlam

items.t: Where the condo stock concentrates: one cluster only — the Pinetree Way / Glen Drive / Atlantic Avenue tower corridor at the City Centre edge (Oasis, MThree, the three Grand Central buildings, Altamonte, Parc Laurent), beside Coquitlam Centre and the Evergreen Line stations.

Transit anchors: the Evergreen Extension (Millennium Line) stations Coquitlam Central, Lincoln and Lafarge Lake-Douglas serve the City Centre edge on Pinetree Way and Barnet Highway, and Coquitlam Central also has West Coast Express service.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Central Coquitlam

items.t: Watercourse protection: the Watercourse Protection Development Permit Area covers all areas within 30 metres of the top of bank or top of ravine bank of any watercourse in this part of Coquitlam, and Zoning Bylaw s.519 sets flood protection setbacks from watercourses while s.523 covers riparian areas — a strata capital-planning and lot check, not a tower-interior issue.

blocks.text: Good to know about Central Coquitlam

items.t: A buyer searching only one label sees only part of the cluster.
Grand Central 3's build year is not settled in public sources. Current listings and listing records mostly say 2014; one listing record says 2012.

The next tower at the cluster is mostly not condos you can assume. Pine & Glen's 705 condos come with 186 market rental apartments in a separate 22-storey tower on the same podium — rental-only stock that will show up in "units at Pine & Glen" counts but never in strata resale.

MThree's amenity club is at the top, not the podium. Cressey's project page puts The Summit Club — 9,000 sq. ft. of amenities — at the top of the 48-storey tower, and current listings place the cardio and weight rooms on the 47th and 48th floors with a garden space on the 5th. Amenity location affects which floors carry view-and-amenity premiums.
The interior's density story is suites, not strata.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Central Coquitlam
Streets, schools and getting around Central Coquitlam

items.t: Where attached stock concentrates: one cluster only — the Pinetree Way / Glen Drive / Atlantic Avenue tower corridor at the City Centre edge, beside Coquitlam Centre and the Evergreen Line stations.

Transit: the Evergreen Extension (Millennium Line) stations Coquitlam Central, Lincoln and Lafarge Lake-Douglas serve the City Centre edge on Pinetree Way and Barnet Highway, and Coquitlam Central also has West Coast Express service.

Library and care: Coquitlam Public Library City Centre branch, 1169 Pinetree Way, and Poirier branch, 575 Poirier Street; Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody, is the nearest hospital (Fraser Health).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Central Coquitlam

items.t: Form B diligence (strata purchases generally — there is no counted strata townhouse here to apply it to): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.

blocks.text: Good to know about Central Coquitlam

items.t: Coquitlam replaced its OCP in 2026 (dated fact): Council adopted the Interim Official Community Plan (Bylaws 5511/5512, 2026) on April 27, 2026, superseding OCP No. 3479; the City states the update cut the policy count by about 70%, introduced no new growth areas except as provincial law required, and is the foundation for a fuller OCP update anticipated to begin in 2027. Any page still citing OCP No. 3479 as current is out of date.

Hideaway Park carries a redevelopment fact beside its 55+ marketing: the same 5.76-acre, 68-pad site at 4200 Dewdney Trunk Road has been described in a development-marketing document as a transit-oriented multifamily opportunity in a Shoulder Station Area near the Evergreen Line — a park buyer should read that document as carefully as the park's own marketing.
Two near-identical Burlington names, opposite answers: Burlington Estates (2963 / 2973 Burlington Drive, built 1987) is the verified 55+ building. Verify the civic address, not the street name.

The Dufferin Street pair is a care continuum in two addresses: a rental retirement residence (Parkwood Manor, 1142 Dufferin St) and a complex-care centre (Dufferin Care Centre, 1131 Dufferin St) sit on the same short street — relevant context for a buyer purchasing for a later care move, and neither is buyable stock.

Property-tax penalties here are two-step (2026): due July 2, 2026, then 5% on any unpaid balance after July 2 and a further 5% after September 15, 2026, including unclaimed Home Owner Grants — a closing-date adjustment item for summer completions.

blocks.text: Central Coquitlam home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

26 condos sold in Central Coquitlam with a median price of $426,250 (the middle half sold between $350,000 and $604,250), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 12% sold above list. They had a median $516 per square foot, a median year built of 1982 and a median strata fee of $454 a month. 5 townhomes sold in Central Coquitlam with a median price of $617,500, taking a median of 22 days to sell at 98.8% of the last list price; 20% sold above list. They had a median $617 per square foot, a median year built of 1976 and a median strata fee of $330 a month.

faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 33 condos and townhomes listed in Central Coquitlam. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Central Coquitlam?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Central Coquitlam had a sales ratio of 3%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is Central Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: 18 condos and townhomes sold in Central Coquitlam over those 5 months, out of 596 in all of Coquitlam.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Central Coquitlam from June to October 2026?

faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?

faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC. Short-term rentals are a separate question: a bylaw can still restrict them, and Pine & Glen's neighbouring 22-storey tower is purpose-built market rental, not strata stock.
faq.q: Can I rent out a tower unit long-term?

faq.a: Unit listings record cats OK at MThree, Grand Central 3 and Altamonte, and the directory records pets allowed at Oasis. Pet bylaws remain enforceable in BC and building-level published sets are thin — the registered bylaws in the Form B package govern for the specific building.
faq.q: Are pets allowed in the towers?

faq.a: Compare each building's own depreciation report and CRF, not the complex name.
faq.q: How do the three Grand Central buildings differ?

faq.a: Onni's project at 1175 Pinetree Way: 705 condominiums in 50- and 45-storey towers plus 186 market rental apartments in a 22-storey tower, over a 6-storey podium with retail, office and a daycare, estimated completion 2028. Presale contracts carry the REDMA 7-day rescission right, and new-build GST applies with the FTHB GST rebate and BC Newly Built Home Exemption in play for qualifying buyers.
faq.q: What will Pine & Glen add, and when?

faq.a: The attached stock that does exist by name is the Pinetree Way / Glen Drive tower cluster (apartment condos) and the Town Centre apartment-form 55+ buildings. A listing calling a tower unit a "townhome" does not make the building a townhouse complex.
faq.q: Are there any townhouse complexes in Central Coquitlam?

faq.a: Yes under provincial law — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since Nov 24, 2022; short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw. Read the registered bylaws in the Form B package.
faq.q: Can I rent out a strata unit here long-term?

faq.a: No verified 55+ townhouse. The verified 55+ ownership stock is apartment-form (Marlborough House, Princess Gate, Burlington Estates) plus pad-rental manufactured homes at Hideaway Park — neither is a townhouse complex.

faq.q: What did condos in Central Coquitlam sell for?
faq.a: 26 condos sold in Central Coquitlam between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $426,250.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Central Coquitlam?
faq.a: The median was 21 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.1% of the last list price (12% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
